title: Blue Boy
description: This adorable blue boy has a wonderfully soft, fluffy coat in a lovely smoky grey shade, complemented by delicate lighter highlights around his face. His wide, round eyes and sweet little expression give him an irresistible charm, while his wispy ears and tiny paws add to his endearing appearance. There’s something particularly lovely about his gentle, thoughtful gaze, as though he’s quietly discovering the world around him. A delightful little Maine Coon boy with a soft, cuddly appearance and plenty of character already showing through.
